sections.title: Power Matched to the Door
sections.content: Estate-size Keller homes often have wide, heavy, insulated doors, and an underpowered opener on a door like that grinds, slows, and burns out early. We size the opener to the door's weight, which on many Keller doors means a higher horsepower belt-drive unit, so it lifts smoothly without straining. Quiet operation matters in these homes, and a properly matched belt-drive runs near silently even on a large door. We also confirm the springs are carrying the door correctly, since the opener should guide the door, not hoist it.

sections.title: Multiple Bays and Clean Installs
sections.content: Many Keller homes have two or three garage bays, and we install and sync openers across all of them so the remotes, keypads, and HomeLink work as one system. We service LiftMaster, Genie, Chamberlain, and Craftsman, repair worn gears and misaligned sensors, and handle full replacements with force and travel calibration.
